episodes.title: Model 101
episodes.summary: In 1997, a haunted scientist brushes his family aside for an all-consuming project. In 2022, a renegade fighter battles a powerful robot for vital data.

episodes.title: Model 102
episodes.summary: Eiko and the Terminator arrive in 1997 with identical missions: find Dr. Malcolm Lee. Meanwhile, Lee's three children sneak out of their apartment.

episodes.title: Model 103
episodes.summary: Malcolm confides in Kokoro about his recurring nightmare. The three children continue their underground trek, unaware of looming danger.

episodes.title: Model 104
episodes.summary: As a desperate Eiko attempts to elude the police, Misaki's mysterious past comes into focus. Malcolm wrestles with the nature of fate.

episodes.title: Model 105
episodes.summary: Malcolm brings Kokoro online. The boys disagree about Misaki's motivations. Eiko realizes she's entering unknown territory.

episodes.title: Model 106
episodes.summary: The Prophet debates the paradox of time travel with Eiko. Malcolm shares a painful memory with Kokoro as the children hope to reunite at Cat Town.

episodes.title: Model 107
episodes.summary: Malcolm recalls past efforts to thwart the machines — and his desire to build a god. With Kenta captured, the Terminator prepares for the endgame.

episodes.title: Model 108
episodes.summary: Kenta wrestles with a brutal choice and the Terminator reveals a shocking truth as the future of humankind hangs in the balance.
